scenes.title: A major
scenes.subtitle: Three fingers on fret 2.
lines: In this lesson, you'll learn the A major chord — three fingers on fret 2.
It's part of level 3 of 12, 'First chords'.

scenes.heading: A major (A)
lines: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3 on fret 2, across strings 4, 3 and 2.
Angle them slightly to make the squeeze easier.
You've got this, one chord at a time.
The A major chord uses three fingers on fret 2 and plays strings 5 through 1, skipping string 6.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: Three fingers share fret 2, so angle them slightly; finger 3 can sit a little further from the fret. Keep string 1 ringing.

lines: Let's practice moving between A minor and A major.
Focus on smooth transitions — your fingers will get faster with time.
Place fingers 1-3 on fret 2, angle them, and strum from string 5.
Now play it — the app will listen and help you sound your best.
